meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 获取当前分支 PR/MR 的 Qodo 审核意见，然后逐一或批量修复问题，并向每条评论回复决定。支持 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps。
howto.when: 当你要求查看代码审查、Qodo 问题或修复 Qodo 评论时触发。需要当前在 git 仓库、有打开的 PR/MR 且已被 Qodo 审核。

say.text: 看看这个 PR 的 Qodo 审核问题。
say.note: 显示所有 Qodo 提出的审核问题。

say.text: 帮我全部修复 Qodo 指出的关键问题。
say.note: 自动应用所有标记为“修复”的建议。

howto.what_en: Fetches Qodo review issues for the current PR/MR, then interactively or automatically fixes them and replies to each inline comment with the decision. Supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view code review, Qodo issues, or fix Qodo comments. Requires being in a git repo with an open PR/MR that Qodo has reviewed.

say_en.text: Show me the Qodo review issues for this PR.
say_en.note: Displays all issues from Qodo review.

say_en.text: Fix all critical Qodo issues automatically.
say_en.note: Applies fixes for all issues marked 'Fix' without individual approval.
